response.overview: Isolated and eager to belong, a lonely college freshman becomes captivated by a masc atler tomboy who loves to smoke and takes up the habit of herself, hoping that she will "betamax" him. but as her feelings deepen, she finds herself consumed by a longing that begins to reshape the way she sees herself and the world around her.
response.title: How to Yosi (YuNg 5m0k!ng pho3)
